products.name: Chefman TurboFry Touch 6 Qt Dual-Basket Air Fryer
products.headline: Two 3-quart baskets that finish at the same moment
products.dek: The one to get if dinner is usually a protein and a side. Two independent baskets, and a Sync Finish setting so both halves of the meal are ready together.
good_fit: You regularly cook two different things at once - wings in one basket, fries in the other.
You want both baskets to finish together without doing the timer math yourself (Sync Finish).
You like to watch food brown without pulling a basket: both baskets have viewing windows and there is an interior light.
think_twice: Each basket is 3 Qt, so one large item has to fit in half of the machine's total capacity.
At 13.38 x 11.81 x 10.63 in it is not the smallest unit on this site; measure your counter first.

products.name: Chefman TurboFry Touch 8 Qt Air Fryer
products.headline: One big basket, four presets, nothing to learn
products.dek: The straightforward choice: a single 8-quart basket - the largest single basket on this site - four one-touch presets and a shake reminder. Chefman says it is designed for 4-6 people.
good_fit: You cook one thing in a big batch - a family-size tray of fries or a pile of wings.
You want few buttons: four presets (fries, chicken, fish, meat) plus manual time and temperature.
You forget to shake the basket: an LED shake reminder prompts you.
think_twice: Only one basket - two different foods share the same time and temperature.
The maximum temperature is published two ways (400 °F by Chefman, '450°F Hi-Fry' in the Amazon title); if high-heat crisping matters to you, confirm it before buying.

products.name: Emeril Lagasse French Door AirFryer 360, 26 QT
products.headline: An oven with French doors that also air fries
products.dek: Not really a basket air fryer at all: a 26-quart countertop convection oven with dual French doors, a rotisserie and ten cooking functions. It can stand in for a toaster oven too, but it is the deepest machine here.
good_fit: You want one appliance to roast, bake, broil, dehydrate, proof and air fry.
You cook for a group - Emeril sizes it for 4-6 people - or want room for a rotisserie.
You prefer opening doors to pulling out a basket.
think_twice: At 16.9 in deep it needs real counter depth - measure under your upper cabinets.
The preset and accessory counts differ between official pages (see the table); go by what matters to you, not by the number.

products.name: ThermoMaven 1-Second Instant-Read Digital Meat Thermometer
products.headline: Dip it, read it, done - in about a second
products.dek: A handheld instant-read probe: you check the thickest part of the meat, read the number, and pull it out. The listing states ±0.5 °F accuracy with NIST certification and a 1-second reading.
good_fit: You want a quick yes/no on doneness for chicken, burgers, pork chops or fish.
You cook in an air fryer or on a grill and open it to check anyway.
You want something waterproof you can rinse under the tap.
think_twice: It is not a leave-in probe - for a long roast or smoke you will be opening the oven to check.
Amazon shows a newer model of this item on the listing; compare both before buying.

products.name: CHEF iQ Sense Smart Wireless Meat Thermometer (3 probes)
products.headline: Leave three probes in and watch from your phone
products.dek: Wireless leave-in probes that report to an app over WiFi and Bluetooth. Three probes means three proteins - or three steaks at three donenesses - in one cook.
products.badge: Best for roasts and long cooks
good_fit: You roast, smoke or grill long cooks and want alerts instead of hovering.
You cook more than one protein at a time.
You want rest timers and estimated finish times from an app.

For a quick weeknight chicken breast, a leave-in system is more than you need.
